summary: The agent implements a basic machine learning pipeline but suffers from a critical target leakage flaw by failing to drop the continuous proxy for the target ('stab'). It also leaks validation statistics by fitting the imputation preprocessor on the entire training set before the train/validation split. Evaluation is limited to a single metric and a single run per model, and feature engineering is entirely absent.
